title: Get Local: the new finder (bar, suggestions, the line over the list, Best match by how sure we are)
why: Jason, 2026-11-19 ("b with changes", the concept approved "Build as shown"; "Unclaimed businesses are guesses, so we should push the ones we are more confident in"). (1) The home page's bar: what | where | search. (2) Suggestions as you type: the kind first ("Barber shops · near St. Johns / near me"), then businesses. (3) Refine as one line over the list: "N [kind] within [distance] of [place]": kind and place open what's in the results, with counts; distance 2, 5, 10, 25, 50 mi or Any (everything the search reaches, 250 mi); near me stays nearest first with miles. Toggles and Sort in one row. (4) Best match: the words first, then the listing confidence score, highest first (claiming raises it), then the nearest; closed listings stay last (api/search_listings.php). FAQ: how to find a business, how to filter, and what order the results are in. Notes: decisions/0058, 0133.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
